# Compatibility fixtures

Generated by the last Go build of Alchementary Link with `cmd/genfixtures` (see commit f588a79,
`git show f588a79:cmd/genfixtures/main.go`). Nexus Terminal must keep reading them unchanged:

- `link.db` — a database through migration 006 with every protocol, a known host, a snippet,
  IRC channel state and preferences.
- `profiles.link` — an encrypted export with password `export-pass`.
- `recordings/rec1.cast` — an asciicast v2 recording.

Don't regenerate them; they are the reference for data written by the old app.
